exposure_ledger.attempt_terminality: An unfinished attempt has neither evaluation_completion (completed or failed) nor evaluation_interrupted. Each attempt may receive exactly one of those terminal records. Completion after interruption, interruption after completion, a second interruption or duplicate completion refuses ledger validation. Any new scoring after a terminal record requires a new evaluation_id/attempt and inherits exposure. A saved result from an interrupted attempt may be retained as non-scoring evidence but cannot receive a retroactive completion or regain freshness.
exposure_ledger.avoid_hash_cycle: completion binds result payload, not the final quality envelope; final envelope binds completion snapshot; an optional later attachment record may bind envelope but is outside that evaluation snapshot
exposure_ledger.completion_failure: A failed completion retains every computed result and explicit uncomputed states; no invented block verdict. Failed or interrupted attempts remain possible prior exposure for related later scoring.
exposure_ledger.evaluation_id_generation: Generate a lowercase canonical UUIDv4 with the standard OS-random UUID library before appending the attempt; check uniqueness across the verified ledger and all linked recovery histories. Collision is refused, never silently reused. UUID identity supplies uniqueness only, not authority or chronology.
exposure_ledger.evaluation_identity: evaluation_id is unique within and across linked recovery ledgers; duplicate attempt/completion IDs, dangling parents, forked tips and mismatched identity bindings refuse scoring or quality attachment. Rerunning a completed attempt requires a new recorded attempt and inherits exposure.
exposure_ledger.exposure_status_precedence: First, missing history/reservation/ancestry returns exposure_history_unknown. Otherwise nonreserved families return not_reserved_conformity. Otherwise a reserved family with any earlier related attempt/external exposure returns post_exposure_conformity; only the remaining reserved first-attempt case may be fresh_same_source_holdout_eligible. No completed numeric score is required for prior exposure.

exposure_status_values.exposure_history_unknown: History or ancestry is incomplete for this block; scope_incomplete.
exposure_status_values.fresh_same_source_holdout_eligible: Reserved B19001/B25003 only, satisfying first_attempt; never independent-source evidence.
exposure_status_values.not_reserved_conformity: S0101 population/age (and any explicitly nonreserved diagnostic family): ordinary benchmark conformity; these may be calibration targets and carry no holdout claim. Complete history/ancestry is still required for an approved overall scope.
exposure_status_values.post_exposure_conformity: Reserved family with a verified earlier related attempt/external exposure, even if interrupted or failed; no fresh holdout claim.

exposure_ledger.first_attempt: fresh_same_source_holdout_eligible only with approved exact protocol, complete prior-history/reservation/ancestry audit and no earlier related attempt/external exposure for any same-family root or derivative; this is same-source, never independent-source evidence
exposure_ledger.format: append-only NDJSON; each line is exact canonical JSON record followed by LF; no BOM; reject duplicate keys, malformed/nonfinite/unknown fields; immutable snapshots retained
exposure_ledger.interrupted_writer: OS releases lock on process exit; successor verifies chain and appends interruption for unfinished attempt before another scoring attempt. A started attempt is conservatively exposed for related later attempts even if completion is absent.
exposure_ledger.later_parameter_change: new immutable protocol with parent/change reasons, still post_exposure_conformity for related families; prior results are immutable under their original parameters; no retroactive reclassification

other_event_types.evaluation_attempt: must append and fsync BEFORE any candidate/reference discrepancy is computed or inspected
other_event_types.evaluation_completion: must refer to unique unfinished attempt and immutable result payload; append and fsync
other_event_types.evaluation_interrupted: unfinished attempt ID/hash, interruption/recovery reason, known output hashes or explicit unknown, exposure_possible=true; never erased or treated fresh
other_event_types.external_exposure_recorded: known prior evaluation/inspection IDs, related ancestry, block families, timestamps, artifacts; cannot claim completeness solely from this new ledger
other_event_types.ledger_recovery: new ledger links exact prior file/prefix hashes and unresolved attempt/exposure state; does not erase corrupt/incomplete history
other_event_types.protocol_amended: new approved protocol hash, exact parent hash, full old/new/reason changes; inherits all exposure history
other_event_types.protocol_registered: registration payload above; approval requires exact immutable evidence

exposure_ledger.partial_or_corrupt_tail: refuse scoring with scope_incomplete ledger_integrity_unknown; preserve whole original file; explicit recovery into new linked ledger may retain validated prefix but must preserve unresolved exposure; never truncate history to regain freshness
exposure_ledger.protocol_amendment_order: Before scoring under any amended protocol, append its identity-bound root/peer approval and parent/changes record. A proposal/amendment cannot relabel or overwrite earlier results.
exposure_ledger.purpose: local auditable provenance, not tamperproof external witnessing or proof of unrecorded-history absence
quality_binding_order: capture ledger snapshot before attempt, append/fsync attempt
compute permitted results and exclusively write immutable result payload bound to protocol/candidate/population/reference/attempt hash and prior snapshot
append/fsync completion referencing result payload hash and block verdicts
capture immutable ledger prefix through completion
write final quality envelope binding result payload hash, protocol hash, candidate/population identities, attempt hash, completion hash and exact post-completion ledger snapshot
exposure_ledger.quality_write_interruption: if completion exists and final envelope write failed, reconstruct only from the same immutable result and ledger prefix; no new scoring or freshness reset

record_fields.actor_id: declared local actor identity, not authenticated external signature
record_fields.previous_record_sha256: null only at sequence 0; otherwise SHA256 of previous canonical record bytes excluding LF

exposure_ledger.record_hash: SHA256(canonical record bytes), no self-hash field; previous hash covers complete previous record
exposure_ledger.reference_family_identity: table-family roots plus exact source pins; version/format/hash changes or renamed derivatives do not reset family exposure; occupied-HU total comparison marks both B19001 and B25003 aliases
exposure_ledger.related_tuning_ancestry: same tuning-family root; candidate descendant of a prior evaluated/tuned population; or shared/derived mutable fitting, hyperparameter, model-selection or pipeline-selection decisions. Shared immutable Census source alone is same-source dependence, not automatically shared tuning ancestry. Complete typed provenance must establish separation; uncertainty is not fresh.
exposure_ledger.reservation: B19001 and B25003 and every derivative remain excluded from fitting, tuning and selection; ancestry audit must traverse aliases, sums, shares, coarsenings, geographic transforms and rescalings
exposure_ledger.single_writer: exclusive OS advisory lock on a stable lockfile before reading latest tip; hold through attempt append/fsync, scoring, result write, completion append/fsync and final quality-envelope write; other writer waits or returns ledger_busy before scoring; do not unlink lockfile or infer ownership from a PID file
exposure_ledger.subsequent_related_attempt: post_exposure_conformity for B19001/B25003 after any prior related attempt or external exposure; numeric outcomes remain unchanged; never fresh holdout evidence
exposure_ledger.transport_integration: future candidate-quality producer and reader must verify this binding and preserve reserved/exposed statuses; this proposal does not claim current transport already enforces it
exposure_ledger.unknown_or_incomplete_lineage_history: scope_incomplete reason exposure_history_unknown; do not issue fresh or certified post-exposure status from a guessed history

identity.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON; sorted keys; compact separators; no BOM or trailing LF; no nonfinite values; thresholds are exact decimal strings
identity.hash_scope: entire proposal JSON bytes; no self-hash member
identity.schema_and_revision: schema names the proposal representation family (v1); protocol_id and parent SHA identify content revisions. A reader validates the exact approved canonical hash and declared fields; a schema-family label alone never authorizes unknown fields or activates a revision.

status_contract.benchmark_conforming: all complete mandatory point/distribution and known support bounds satisfied for the stated scope, no truth/launch claim

diagnostic_blocks: raw MOE intervals and eligible discrepancy/MOE ratios
IRS transformed benchmarks under their separate provisional contract
status_contract.invalid_weight_or_mass: scope_incomplete reason invalid_reducer_input; no silent absolute value, clipping, renormalization or drop

no_rescue: high clone count or ESS alone

reason_codes.candidate_identity_unavailable: Mandatory candidate or producer identity artifact is missing/unreadable.
reason_codes.denominator_unknown: Universe membership or denominator cannot be established, regardless estimated mass.
reason_codes.exposure_history_unknown: Reservation, external exposure or related tuning ancestry is incomplete.
reason_codes.gq_weight_bridge_missing: GQ source-person weights lack an approved authenticated representation and reducer binding.
reason_codes.invalid_reducer_input: Nonfinite/negative mass, invalid weights or failed partition arithmetic.
reason_codes.ledger_busy: Another writer holds the stable ledger lock; no scoring has started.
reason_codes.ledger_integrity_unknown: Corrupt/forked/mismatched/unterminated ledger evidence cannot be validated.
reason_codes.mapping_unapproved: Required concept, period, universe, geography or reducer mapping is absent or unapproved, regardless mass.
reason_codes.protocol_unapproved: Required action lacks verified exact-hash root/peer approval and registration.
reason_codes.published_benchmark_nonconformity: Known point or distribution metric exceeds its declared bound; retain block/bin/metric and magnitude.
reason_codes.reference_invalid: Reference sentinel/annotation class is unusable; retain its exact reference_status.invalid_classes detail and raw evidence.
reason_codes.reference_precision_inadequate: Ordinary reference precision violates the predeclared ceiling or a required approximation is unavailable.
reason_codes.required_cell_or_district_missing: Any mandatory reference or candidate cell/district is unavailable.
reason_codes.source_domain_refused: Authenticated source adapter refuses out-of-domain source codes; no classification artifact or mass may be fabricated.
reason_codes.support_bound_exceeded: Known source-origin support metric violates its declared bound; retain metric and magnitude.
reason_codes.unclassified_fraction_exceeded: Known denominator and approved mapping, but unclassified fraction exceeds 0.005.
reason_codes.unresolved_source_lineage: Any in-scope record, including zero-weight records, lacks authenticated original-source lineage.
reason_codes.vacancy_bridge_missing: ACS NP0 exclusion lacks the separately approved authenticated vacancy bridge.
reason_codes.zero_candidate_denominator: Candidate distribution denominator is zero; preserve separately evaluable totals.

status_contract.reason_encoding: Reasons are a deduplicated list drawn only from reason_codes. Multiple independently established reasons may coexist. Block/bin/metric IDs and original source/refusal/annotation detail are separate bounded evidence fields, never replacement primary reason codes. Unknown primary codes refuse validation.
status_contract.scope_incomplete: mandatory identity, mapping, denominator, precision, lineage, exposure history, cell or district evidence unavailable/unapproved; or unclassified known-denominator fraction above 0.005
scope_reduction_order: any incomplete mandatory block/district makes overall scope_incomplete while retaining all already-known benchmark_nonconforming results
otherwise any mandatory nonconformity gives benchmark_nonconforming

support.ESS: (sum(c_o))^2/sum(c_o^2), after clone aggregation by original source household
support.HU_measure_contribution: sum eligible HU contributions within source origin
support.bin_support: apply same origin grouping to each positive published reference bin; zero candidate bin mass fails carrier/concentration support without division by zero
support.known_below_floor: benchmark_nonconforming reason support_bound_exceeded; not proof of bias
support.origin_contribution: sum all finite nonnegative contributions to the relevant denominator/bin from records/clones with the same authenticated original source-household key BEFORE ESS/count/max calculation
support.origin_record_coverage: every record in the claimed universe, including zero-weight records, must have authenticated origin; unknown universe membership remains incomplete separately
support.person_measure_contribution: sum eligible person contributions within source household, including appropriate GQ source units; not household count weights silently substituted for person mass
support.reference_zero_unknown_bin_carrier_floor: not_applicable; retain mass and origin diagnostics
